summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Acronis Billing + Recurring Invoice Auto-Attach feature. All 13 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified: Create/Edit dialogs have Acronis Auto toggle with Cloud icon and descriptive text, Backup Command Center Billing tab shows per-client cards with Link/Disable Auto-Bill buttons and Auto-Billed via Recurring badges.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing client-001 (Acme Corporation) with Acronis link
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 102 tested the Acronis Billing + Recurring Invoice Auto-Attach feature. Backend endpoints verified: GET /api/acronis/billing/preview (returns auto_bill_recurring + active_recurring_invoices), POST /api/acronis/billing/client/{id}/link-to-recurring (enables include_acronis_usage on all active RIs), POST /api/acronis/billing/client/{id}/link-to-recurring with create_if_missing (creates scaffold RI), POST /api/acronis/billing/client/{id}/unlink-recurring (disables include_acronis_usage), GET /api/recurring-invoices/by-client/{id}, POST /api/recurring-invoices/{id}/set-acronis-auto, POST /api/recurring-invoices/create with include_acronis_usage, POST /api/recurring-invoices/scheduler/run-now (auto-attaches Acronis usage). Frontend verified: RecurringInvoicesPage create/edit dialogs have Acronis Auto toggle (data-testid=ri-acronis-auto-toggle, ri-edit-acronis-auto-toggle), BackupCommandCenterPage Billing tab has per-client cards with Link/Disable buttons (data-testid=auto-bill-toggle-{client_id}) and Auto-Billed via Recurring badges (data-testid=auto-bill-badge-{client_id}).
